resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, all effective Arabic runtime entries, the Arabic glossary, prior review metadata, and technical terminology searches were available.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation, runtime escape scans, source comparison, and TypeScript checking passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: Three complete-scope passes resolved 75 catalog, comparison, calculator, shared-interface, and concept findings.

competentHumanReview.summary: The Arabic corrections were machine-reviewed and still require competent human review.

publicationAuthorization.summary: This cycle authorizes a locale-specific commit only, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Twenty-five catalog and comparison entries obscured cycle life, tester attribution, exact selector identities, or profile availability.
evidence: Cycle life was rendered as general operating life.
The human tester was rendered as a test device.
Comparison selectors dropped the canonical A and B identities.
findings.resolution: Corrected evidence-note semantics, verified-profile language, product identity spacing, selector labels, and comparison guidance.

findings.summary: Twenty-five calculator and shared-runtime entries altered engineering unit symbols or retained machine-literal prompts and status wording.
evidence: Editor labels expanded g, mm, g/cm³, and °C into inconsistent localized abbreviations.
Preset and material selectors used less natural command wording.
Current headroom lacked its safety-margin meaning.
findings.resolution: Preserved unit notation and corrected voltage, preset, availability, catalog-search, and research-record language.

findings.summary: Twenty-five technical concept entries retained inaccurate resistance-heating semantics, topology calques, or inconsistent heat-transfer and SI terminology.
evidence: The Joule summary omitted that current passes through resistance.
Series-cell capacity and lithium-ion charging explanations were imprecise.
Several SI and wire-gauge headings remained literal machine translations.
findings.resolution: Revised electrical topology, heating, TCR, trigonometry, heat-transfer, SI-prefix, and wire-gauge explanations.
